name: claude-code-rtl
description: Read Claude Code (and any LTR webview) Arabic / Hebrew / Persian replies correctly — a clean RTL mirror panel with auto direction, theme-aware styling, and one-click text utilities.

commands.title: Claude Code RTL: Open Mirror Panel
Claude Code RTL: Mirror Clipboard Now
Claude Code RTL: Mirror Editor Selection
Claude Code RTL: Toggle Clipboard Auto-Watch
Claude Code RTL: Clear Mirror Panel
Claude Code RTL: Enable In-Chat RTL (patch Claude Code)
Claude Code RTL: Disable In-Chat RTL (remove patch)

claudeCodeRtl.autoWatchClipboard.description: Automatically push new clipboard text into the RTL Mirror panel when it contains Arabic/Hebrew/Persian characters.

claudeCodeRtl.watchIntervalMs.description: Polling interval (ms) used by the clipboard auto-watcher.

claudeCodeRtl.fontFamily.description: Override the mirror panel font. Leave empty to inherit the VS Code editor font.

claudeCodeRtl.fontSize.description: Font size used inside the mirror panel.

claudeCodeRtl.openOnStartup.description: Open the RTL Mirror panel automatically when VS Code starts.

claudeCodeRtl.patchClaudeCode.description: Inject right-to-left CSS into the installed Claude Code extension so its chat panel renders Arabic / Hebrew / Persian replies natively. The patch is scoped to a marked block and can be removed at any time via the 'Disable In-Chat RTL' command.
